استهلوا (form X)
# اِسْتَهَلُّوا (istahallū) /is.ta.hal.luː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَهَلَّ (istahalla)
# اُسْتُهِلُّوا (ustuhillū) /us.tu.hil.luː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَهَلَّ (istahalla)
# اِسْتَهِلُّوا (istahillū) /is.ta.hil.luː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَهَلَّ (istahalla)
